scale_note: 0=Calm, 100=Captured/Non-functional. Bands: Calm 0-39, Strained 40-59, Warning 60-74, Critical 75-100. Scores are hand-set per review; wire citations belong in the note field.

institutions.name: Federal Courts
institutions.why: Delta +1 from 83. Three appellate outcomes in four days, all of them decided by posture rather than merits. The Eighth Circuit denied the environmental groups' emergency request and cleared the Army's lead-azide permit (11-23), after which the executive proceeded; the Ninth Circuit granted the Justice Department's motion to dismiss its OWN California ballot suit (11-23), ending the 20,000-ballot sequestration route with ballots counted and the state certified; the Second Circuit revived the federal removal of the hush-money case (11-23). And in the Omar case the judge who signed the 12 October warrant is now on the record, in unsealed filings (11-23), repeatedly pressing the department on the protections owed to a member of Congress - a reservation raised, recorded, and routed around. The load keeps arriving and the Court keeps answering procedure rather than substance: it is holding, and holding more of the country's contested questions.

institutions.name: Congress
institutions.why: Re-stated at 80. The one movement in the window is genuine oversight scheduling: Senate Banking chair Tim Scott put Huang before the committee publicly on 3 December with export controls named as central (11-23), and three House committees booked interviews. That is the chamber acting when the object is an individual it can summon - the same pattern as the referral: process when compelled, and the compulsion arrives from outside. Against it, the Omar record shows the House's own counsel recorded as having 'refused to be involved' before a member's home was searched (11-23), which is the House declining a protective role rather than exercising one. No movement; the two facts cancel at this score.

institutions.name: Election Offices
institutions.why: Delta +1 from 82. The count finished and nothing broke. California's 20,000 contested ballots were counted and the state certified after the plaintiff withdrew its own suit; the Ninth Circuit approved the dismissal (11-23). Alaska settled 11-16. Election Day plus three weeks produced no named national Republican refusing a state's result outside Alaska, and the count-refusal card sits at 40 unresolved. The +1 is for capacity demonstrated under a hostile filing rather than for calm: the offices were sued, sequestered, examined, and still delivered a count. The pressure at the legitimacy layer is unchanged, which is why this is not a larger move.

institutions.name: Civil Service

institutions.name: Military Leadership
institutions.why: Re-stated at 78. No new event in the window that bears on the uniformed chain: the Benghazi/Libya strike is a naval-drone story with no reported command friction, and the Pentagon's response to the Kasper resignation call was a statement, not a personnel action. The base-housing arrangement logged at the last review stands.

institutions.name: Dollar & Credit
institutions.why: Delta +2 from 73. The governance risk moved inward at the top of the capital stack. Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang on 11-23, four days after a unanimous on-record statement that it did not intend to reinstate him, with AP attributing the reversal to the President - and Congress responded by summoning the chief executive rather than the board. A board that reverses itself under political direction is a credit fact about the largest company in the index, not a market mood; the same week, the White House asked Congress for $50bn for the air-traffic system with no lifecycle estimate. Top of the Warning band.
